text:
maria-ps: FYI AcmeRetail POC hit intermittent 5xx during demo. Demo timeline 10:18-10:26. Attaching quick summary here, need SRE help ASAP.

andy-sales: ugh, customer saw multiple 502s during a walkthrough. They're worried it's product-ready. Any quick mitigation we can offer?

maria-ps: they're running a burst of long-context chat tests (seq len ~6k) with 10 concurrent sessions. We suspect autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough; logs show backlog then 502s.

sre-bot: ALERT: deploy-autoscale: scale_latency_alert triggered for project=acmeretail-poc (rate: 8e-1, threshold 0.5)

kevin-sre: looking. Can you paste the runtime/error logs and the exact request pattern?

maria-ps: pasted below - these are the runtime rejects from the inference node:

```
[2026-03-15T10:19:12Z] inference-node-7: reject request id=cb12ab code=503 reason="capacity_throttle" details="burst_pool_full"
[2026-03-15T10:19:13Z] router: proxy 502 upstream=inference-node-7 msg="upstream connection reset by peer"
[2026-03-15T10:19:14Z] autoscaler: evaluated pending=24 active=4 target=6 cooldown=45s
[2026-03-15T10:19:18Z] inference-node-9: warn kv_cache pressure high, ongoing generation 2000 tokens
```

raj-se: thanks. Looks like heavy prefix+long generations + many concurrent streams. If the autoscaler cooldown is default 45s it might not keep up with spikes. Two quick mitigations: 1) increase burst_pool size for the POC, 2) lower autoscale cooldown to 10s for the demo org.

kevin-sre: we can bump burst_pool for that project (nonprod). I'll also check if any backfill/failover to fallback model happened.

sophie-eng-runtime: from runtime side: we saw a fallback attempt to rwd-small-quant at 10:19:15 but it failed due to capacity tag mismatch (customer pinned to gpu-only pool). That explains the 502 chain.

andy-sales: is "increase burst_pool" something we can promise to customer during this afternoon demo? They want to know cost implications.

raj-se: it's cheap short-term for a POC. Roughly +20% cost for the demo window if we allocate more warm instances. For predictable production we should discuss Dedicated capacity.

kevin-sre: done: increased burst_pool from 8->20 for acmeretail-poc and set a temporary autoscale cooldown to 12s. Pushed change at 10:22:03.

sre-bot: CONFIG CHANGE: burst_pool updated project=acmeretail-poc from 8 to 20 by kevin-sre at 2026-03-15T10:22:03Z

maria-ps: after the bump we still saw a single 502 at 10:23:01 then traffic normalized. Customer resumed demo and didn't see further failures.

andy-sales: fantastic, can we capture the exact timelines / root cause to include in the follow-up email and for the post-mortem?

kevin-sre: short timeline for note:
- 10:18:45 origin: spike in concurrent long sessions (10 conc, long seqs)
- 10:19:12 first rejects on inference-node-7 (burst_pool_full)
- 10:19:15 attempted fallback to rwd-small-quant rejected due to pool tag mismatch
- 10:22:03 ops increased burst_pool + lowered cooldown
- 10:23:01 final observed 502, then steady

sophie-eng-runtime: root cause: workload pattern (many slow, long-token gens) exposed two things: autoscale cooldown too conservative + customer pool pin blocked fallback. Short-term fix applied (burst_pool & cooldown). Long-term: recommend enabling cross-pool fallback or pre-warm reserved instances for demos.

raj-se: for follow-up include repro steps and a suggested config snippet:
```
project: acmeretail-poc
burst_pool: 20
autoscale:
  cooldown_seconds: 12
  target_utilization: 0.65
fallback:
  allow_cross_pool: true  # optional for demos
```

maria-ps: I'll draft the follow-up and include cost estimate + ask if they want Dedicated for stability.

andy-sales: please cc me. Also customer asked about SLA for 5xx during a demo — any wording we should use?

kevin-sre: POV: "Transient 5xx can occur during unexpected bursts; we mitigated by increasing pool warm capacity and tuning autoscale. For production-grade SLAs, recommend Dedicated capacity or pre-warmed reserved instances."

maria-ps: thanks team. tagging this for a short postmortem doc.

kevin-sre: leaving a quick todo: run a load-replay with same pattern (10 conc, seq=6k) against our staging to validate cooldown=12s and allow_cross_pool flag. I'll create a run and paste results here tomorrow.

andy-sales: sounds good. Customer happy for now. :thumbsup:
